Type: deco
Name: Amazon Brand – Rivet Modern Velvet Lines Throw Pillow - 18 x 18 Inch, Gully Grey
Colors: Gull Grey
Imported The geometric pattern formed with the faux-cording on the gull gray velvet face of this modern throw pillow lends a vibrant contemporary edge to any decor motif. 18"L x 18"W Geometric cotton velvet face; faux cording technique; hidden zipper closure Pillow cover and insert Spot clean only.
